definition_zh: 斜眼地；怀疑地；不以为然地
definition_en: with a sideways glance, especially one of doubt, distrust, or disapproval
core_image: 眼珠斜向一边，眉头微皱的审视目光
scene: 他自称从未见过那封信，同事们交换了眼色，投去怀疑的目光。The manager looked askance at his excuse for missing the deadline.
sceneCN: 这里 askance 是「怀疑地、斜眼地」（第 1 个义项：以不信任的目光看待）；句意是经理斜眼怀疑地看待他迟到的借口。

derivatives.zh: askance 的旧拼写变体，义为「斜眼地」
构词相近的词，义为「歪斜的」

senses.title: With doubt or disapproval
senses.definition: with a sideways look showing distrust or disapproval
senses.definitionCN: 以表示不信任或不赞许的斜视
senses.example: Villagers looked askance at the strangers' fancy clothes.
senses.exampleCN: 村民们斜眼打量陌生人华丽的衣着，满腹狐疑。
senses.why: A squinting sideways glance became the body language of suspicion.
senses.whyCN: 斜睨的目光成了表示怀疑的身体语言。

senses.title: Obliquely, at an angle
senses.definition: at a slanting or sidelong angle
senses.example: The old portrait hung askance on the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 那幅旧画像歪斜地挂在墙上。
senses.why: The sideways angle itself, applied to posture as well as gaze, kept an older spatial sense.
senses.whyCN: 「偏斜」的角度义同时适用于姿态与目光，保留了较早的空间义。

intro.en: Askance is of uncertain origin; it is usually linked to askew or to a Romance root meaning obliquely.
intro.cn: askance 词源不确定，一般与 askew（歪斜）或意为「斜向」的罗曼语词根相关联。

items.en: No certain source is known; etymologists propose a link with askew.
items.cn: 来源不明；词源学家提出与 askew 相关的假说。

items.en: One theory derives it from Italian a schancio, obliquely.
items.cn: 一说源自意大利语 a schancio（斜向）。

items.en: First recorded in the sixteenth century in poetry, meaning sidelong.
items.cn: 首见于十六世纪诗歌，意为斜向地。

items.en: The distrust sense became dominant in Shakespeare's era and after.
items.cn: 莎士比亚时代以后，「怀疑」义成为主流。

items.en: Today it almost always appears in look askance at.
items.cn: 如今几乎只用于 look askance at 短语。

note.en: Askance survives almost only in the phrase look askance at; use it for doubt and disapproval.
note.cn: askance 如今几乎只活在 look askance at 中；用于表达怀疑与不以为然。

entries.definition: twisted to one side; similar prefix and form, possibly related
entries.definitionCN: 歪斜的（形似，或与 askance 同源）

entries.definition: an older spelling variant of askance
to attribute; begins similarly but unrelated
entries.definitionCN: 归因于（拼写开头相似，词源无关）
睡着的（仅同有 a- 开头）

entries.definition: with a look or word of disapproval

normalIntro.en: Hear a scan: eyes scanning sideways in doubt.
normalIntro.cn: 谐音「额斯坎斯」→「额斜看」：额斜眼看，满是怀疑。

normal.en: almost always in look askance at.
normal.cn: 几乎总用于 look askance at。

normal.en: the glance is sideways, not direct.
normal.cn: 这种目光是斜视而非直视。

normal.en: it carries doubt or disapproval, not mere direction.
normal.cn: 它带怀疑或不赞成，而非单纯方向。

normal.en: compare askew, twisted out of line.

abstract.en: Picture one raised eyebrow above slanted eyes.
abstract.cn: 想象斜眼上方挑起的一边眉毛。

abstract.en: Feel the chill of being watched from the corner of a room.
abstract.cn: 体会被房间角落目光斜扫的寒意。

abstract.en: See a tilted picture frame refusing to hang straight.
abstract.cn: 看见拒绝挂正的歪斜画框。

examples.en: The committee looked askance at the unusual proposal.
examples.cn: 委员会对这个不寻常的提案心存疑虑。
评论者们不以为然地看待这部续集。

examples.en: Neighbors viewed the late-night deliveries askance.
examples.cn: 邻居们以怀疑的目光看待深夜的送货。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额斜看」——额把头一偏斜着看，正是 askance 的怀疑斜视。

root: 词源不确定；一说与 askew（歪斜）同源，一说借自罗曼语表示「斜向」的短语。

sensesIntro.en: A sidelong angle becomes a sidelong glance, and the glance becomes judgment.
sensesIntro.cn: 偏斜的角度化为斜睨的目光，目光又化为评判。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: eyes slid sideways, brow slightly furrowed
core.cn: 核心意象：眼珠滑向一侧，眉头微蹙

intro.en: Askance stands alone: its uncertain origin left it without a productive word family.
intro.cn: askance 孤立存在：词源不明使它没有能产的词族。

latinIntro.en: No Latin cognates are known for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 该词没有已知的拉丁同源词。

items.exampleCN: 对该计划投去怀疑的一瞥
